description: Weigel-DeltaB estimates magnetic disturbances at the ground from solar-wind drivers. The documented forecasting method supports geomagnetic-hazard analysis for terrestrial systems. The resource is documented by George Mason University. The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The catalogue entry supplies no execution link; practical access and maintenance remain uncertain. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
